cards.title: LouisAgent.Puls
cards.text: Served by LouisAgent.PulsApi: the landing page, the chat at /gesels, and the admin portal.

cards.title: Run it
cards.text: The compose stack on 5070, or the puls-api program on 5071.

cards.title: Change the chat
cards.text: ChatPage fills the framework's ChatShell; the frame itself is LouisAgent.Web's.

cards.title: Landing and admin
cards.text: A component per section, motion behind chat.motion; AdminLayout and PulsSites.

cards.title: Place its words
cards.text: PulsText.Afrikaans for what C# builds; labels stay in the markup.

cards.title: Test it
cards.text: bUnit against FixtureApi, golden pages, then a look at three widths.
